verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: 10Y yield spike lifts life insurers over P&C
cells.refutation: Life-minus-P&C spread is zero or negative in the t+1 to t+5 window after the yield shock.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare life insurer basket to P&C basket and to XLF; the life-minus-P&C spread should be positive and not explained by broad financials beta.

cells.title: Co-mention read-through after regulatory approval events
cells.refutation: If co-mentioned peers' next-session residual is not more positive than vol-matched unlinked peers (spread <= 0, t < 1), refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare co-mentioned peers to vol-matched unlinked names in the same sub-industry; the linked-minus-unlinked residual spread should be positive.

cells.title: Clinical trial failure read-through to platform partners
cells.refutation: If partner names do not underperform their vol-matched sector controls the next session, or if the effect appears equally in non-partners, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Partner basket should underperform XBI-matched controls with similar size and volatility; effect should be absent for non-partner biotechs.
